repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computed the difference as v2 - v1 (current minus initial), whereas the IR specifies ($v1 - $v2) (initial minus current). Since the input volume rose from 0 to 20, v2 - v1 equals 20, triggering the action. The IR's v1 - v2 equals -20, which is not >= 20, so the IR correctly performs no action. The mismatch is the reversed operand order in the condition.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the operands in the if condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic of detecting a volume drop.
